lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs8Sb4F16 (reduced formula Cs2SbF4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for both Cs and Sb centers: Cs is coordinated by six F neighbors (distances 2.72–2.73 Å), while Sb is coordinated by six F neighbors (2.09–2.12 Å), and F centers bridge one Cs and one Sb. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-sharing between Cs octahedra and corner-sharing between Cs and Sb octahedra.
